boundary_feature_definitions.across_boundary_transition: ordered pair from the final glyph of one readable token to the first glyph of the next readable token in the same readable segment
boundary_feature_definitions.adjacent_exact_repeat_fraction: fraction of readable token boundaries where previous token equals current token exactly
boundary_feature_definitions.boundary_count: number of adjacent readable-token pairs inside readable segments
boundary_feature_definitions.pair_entropy_gap_across_minus_within_bit: across-boundary transition-pair entropy minus within-token transition-pair entropy
boundary_feature_definitions.readable_segment: maximal sequence of readable tokens within one analytical locus, split by any token containing Z1
boundary_feature_definitions.readable_token: nonempty analytical token not containing STA1 Z1
boundary_feature_definitions.repeated_token_occurrence_fraction: fraction of readable token occurrences whose exact token type appears at least twice within the atomic leaf group
boundary_feature_definitions.singleton_token_occurrence_fraction: fraction of readable token occurrences whose exact token type appears exactly once within the atomic leaf group
boundary_feature_definitions.singleton_type_fraction: fraction of exact readable token types occurring exactly once
boundary_feature_definitions.token_length: number of STA1 glyphs in a readable token
boundary_feature_definitions.transition_conditional_entropy_bits: empirical conditional entropy H(next|previous), weighted by observed previous-glyph frequency
boundary_feature_definitions.transition_pair_entropy_bits: empirical Shannon entropy H(previous,next) of observed ordered transition-pair frequencies
boundary_feature_definitions.type_token_ratio: unique readable token types / readable token count
boundary_feature_definitions.within_token_transition: ordered adjacent STA1 glyph pair inside one readable token

correlation_analysis.missing_value_policy: Use only leaves with finite values for that pre-specified feature; report n_used and n_missing.

interpretation_boundary: D2 is exploratory and post-hoc on an already-accessed test set. Correlations are descriptive, not independent tests. D2 cannot reclassify Phase 4, justify excluding leaves, identify a unique historical mechanism, or constitute decipherment.
primary_questions: Which pre-specified token/boundary structural features covary with the D1 boundary boost = token-aware delta - space-free delta?
What structural properties distinguish the two D1 cross-view negative leaf groups, f57 and f49, from the other locked-test leaves?
prohibited_actions: refit or rescore any HMM, trigram, slot grammar, Token-Markov, or copy-edit model
drop f57, f49, or any other leaf from Phase 4
choose features after viewing D2 correlations and present them as preregistered
run subgroup significance tests and call a subgroup confirmatory
change the test split, transcription, STA1 representation, or Z1 reset rule
claim unique mechanism identification or decipherment
purpose: Explain descriptively why preserving Voynich token boundaries increased the HMM-minus-trigram delta on the Phase-4 locked leaves, without refitting models, changing Phase 4, or treating post-hoc associations as confirmatory evidence.

voynich_inputs.unknown_policy: Exclude any token containing STA1 Z1 and reset readable-token segment; never form an across-boundary transition through Z1.
